summary: Tested new Admin CSV export feature on MEALUR Coming Soon (backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 18/18 passed (9 new admin tests covering auth 401s for missing/wrong Bearer/X-Admin-Token/query token, list returns count+subscribers via X-Admin-Token, list via Bearer is sorted by created_at desc with newest first, CSV export via Bearer returns text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment header and 'email,source,created_at' header row containing seeded email, CSV via ?token= query param works, regression POST /api/waitlist still works; plus 9 existing waitlist tests). Frontend: 7/7 passed (login form renders at /admin, invalid token shows 'Invalid admin token' toast and stays on login, valid token logs in + persists to sessionStorage 'mealur_admin_token' + shows total card with count and 10 subscriber rows, refresh button re-fires GET /api/admin/waitlist, Download CSV triggers GET /api/admin/waitlist.csv with 200 + text/csv + attachment Content-Disposition, logout clears sessionStorage and returns to login screen, landing page / regression heading+countdown+email form intact).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx downloadCsv uses window.location.href which navigates the SPA away to the CSV response; works because browser triggers download from Content-Disposition, but on some browsers it briefly shows a blank page then aborts navigation. Consider creating a hidden <a download href=...> click instead, or fetch with Authorization header + Blob URL (avoids exposing token in URL/server logs).
Admin token in CSV URL query param will appear in webserver access logs and browser history. Acceptable trade-off given documented constraint, but worth noting from a security standpoint.

AdminPage.jsx fetchList catches 401 and calls logout() which clears sessionStorage; good. However, the same inline axios call inside handleLogin doesn't reuse fetchList's error handling - minor duplication.
server.py require_admin returns 500 when ADMIN_TOKEN is empty; better DX would be to log a clear startup warning if ADMIN_TOKEN is missing.
Carry-over from iteration_1: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown; EmailForm permanently locks into success state after first submit (page reload required to retry).
seed_data_creation: Created several admintest_/newest_/regress_ prefixed waitlist entries during pytest runs; ~10 total entries visible in admin UI. No cleanup endpoint exists; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin feature fully working. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_admin.py + /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist.py (18 tests, all green). Admin route is /admin (BrowserRouter). data-testids: admin-login-form, admin-token-input, admin-login-button, admin-refresh-button, admin-download-csv-button, admin-logout-button, admin-subscribers-tbody, admin-total-card, admin-subscribers-card, admin-brand-logo. sessionStorage key: mealur_admin_token. CSV download navigates the page via window.location.href - re-navigate to /admin after testing it. Token accepted via Authorization: Bearer, X-Admin-Token header, or ?token= query param (CSV only).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Admin CSV export feature implementation matches spec end-to-end.
